bagPolicy.summary: Fans can bring one clear bag per person not exceeding 12″ x 6″ x 12″ or a one-gallon clear plastic bag. Small purses or clutches no larger than 5″ x 8″ are also allowed.
allowed: clear bag up to 12″ x 6″ x 12″
small purses or clutches up to 5″ x 8″
prohibited: bags larger than the specified sizes
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available for purchase prior to events through ParkWhiz. Consider arriving early and using sustainable transportation options like the city bus or carpooling.

rideshare.note: Use the designated rideshare zone on 1st Street between Denver and Cheyenne for all pickup and drop-off. Select BOK Center in your app and follow the signs.

concessions.note: BOK Center offers a variety of food and drink options, including fast and casual chicken from Big Chicken, traditional arena fare, and unique offerings like boozy slushies from Slush Rush. The venue is cashless, accepting only debit/credit cards for payment.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available on all levels through Ticketmaster (use "Request Accessible Seating") or AXS (check the "Accessible Seating" box), with adjacent companion seats based on availability. Free wheelchair escorts can be requested at any entry from Guest Services or Security staff.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Once you exit BOK Center, re-entry is strictly prohibited.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The QuikTrip Box Office at BOK Center is located at the corner of 3rd St & Frisco Ave. On event days that fall on the weekend, the box office will open 2 hours prior to door time.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For most events, doors open 60 minutes before start time, but this varies, so check your event page. Every entrance has walk-through metal detectors, so arrive early. Guests with disabilities can be dropped off on West 3rd Street between Denver and Frisco Avenues and use the Main Entrance.
